WHAT IS TIRE ROTATION? Tire rotation is periodically changing the position of each of the tires on your vehicle. You should rotate your tires as recommended by the vehicle manufacturer, when you get your oil changed or every 5,000 miles. For many of you, that will mean when you get your vehicles oil changed. Regularly rotating your tires also gives your service technician a good opportunity to visually inspect them for damage, check their air pressure, have them re-balanced if youre noticing any vibration, and check their tread depth.

Tire FAQ's How do I know if my tires need replacing? Youll need new tires if the Tread Wear Indicators at three or more places around the tire can be seen. We recommend that the tires be inspected for signs of wear or damage at least once a month, and that vehicle owners seek professional service if the following are found: Cracks in tire tread or sidewalls Cuts in tires that reveal cord or fabric Bumps, bulges or splits in tires Punctures in tires Any other irreparable damage Why is tire pressure important? An underinflated tire can result in overloading and overheating, blowouts, excessive tire wear, poor handling and reduced fuel economy. Overinflated tires also can result in excessive tire wear Why is tire rotation important? Each tire on a vehicle performs a different task, causing them to wear at different rates. Regular tire rotation allows tires to wear evenly, optimizing tire life and allowing tires to be replaced in sets of four, which is preferable. Public Charging For when you need to recharge on those all-day-getaways, there are public charging stations. Pull up, plug in, recharge, and get going. With over 195,000 chargers and growing, this network ensures you have a charger nearby. Plus, later this year, Chevy customers will have access to 15,000+ Tesla Supercharger locations across North America. Download the myChevrolet Mobile App to get notified when the network opens.

Technology The Ultium platform is built on a modular, flexible battery architecture that empowers EVs of multiple vehicle types with incredible resilience, convenience, and performance. A number of in-vehicle apps assist to keep you in-sync with your EV, and with the myChevrolet Mobile app you can enjoy route-planning power in the palm of your hand.

EV Acceleration, EV Exhilaration Your Chevy EVs battery provides full power to the wheels the second you step on the pedal, giving near instant torque and acceleration. Like a light bulb, the engine doesnt need to build up power; it just turns on instantly like when you flip a light switch. This results in mind-blowing EV acceleration. The joyride doesnt end there; as the EV pack rests in the vehicles floor instead of under the hood, its center of gravity is lower  which means superior stability and handling compared to traditional gas-powered vehicles. Hug those turns with confidence. Powerful Confidence 8-year/100,000-mile battery limited warranty More Fun Near-instant electric torque means more get-up-and-go. Ultium Platform The Ultium EV Platform enables us to make all kinds of exceptional electric vehicles.

Power in Silence The first thing you will probably notice about an EV is the quiet. An electric motor is nearly silent, even at full throttle, helping to create an appreciably calm cabin. Plus, with less components than gas-powered vehicles, there is less vibrating and shaking in an EV, giving you a smooth drive.

All-Electric Future Tech Harness the electric power of your vehicle in innovative ways with these advanced technology features. Regenerative Braking Captures braking energy and transfers it to the battery system. One Pedal Driving Lets you slow down and stop your vehicle using only the accelerator pedal under most conditions. Bidirectional Charging Our EV battery can be used to charge electric bikes, camping equipment  even your house.

More reasons to go electric At Chevrolet, our vision is to create a world with zero crashes, zero emissions and zero congestion. Thats why were constantly working to design impactful technologies, materials and products for a more sustainable future. Were committed to making our global products and operations carbon neutral by 2040. We strive to eliminate tailpipe emissions from new U.S. light-duty vehicles by 2035. Reducing Battery Waste Chevy designs battery packs that are easy to recycle. GM has also created Recycle My Battery, which informs dismantlers on how to disable, remove, store and ship used battery packs from our EVs. Weve developed guidelines for the safe handling and transport of EV batteries by End of Life processors and work to recycle every possible material from every battery.

No. EVs have different drivetrains, fewer moving parts and electrical engines that dont require lubrication. How do electric vehicles work? A large electric battery supplies power to one or more of the electric motors to drive the wheels. Between drives, the owner can plug their EV into a charging station to recharge the battery. Do electric vehicles have transmissions? No, but there is often a stepdown gear to convert the higher motor RPMs to an appropriate wheel speed. Are electric batteries recyclable?
